summary: GET /settings now renders a settings hub instead of redirecting to /settings/logo: searchable cards (name and description) grouped in sections, with empty and no-match states. Components contribute entries with composition.ContributeSettings / AddSettings and hide them with RemoveSettingsPagesByKey; sections merge by Key, pages need a unique Key and an Href, and Name/Description are i18n keys translated at render time (untranslated values render as is). New pkg/settings resolves the registry for the user in a context (Resolve, ResolveFromContext, Source, ResolvedSection, ResolvedPage, shared General/Access/Organization sections). types.SettingsSection gains Key; types.SettingsPage gains Key, Order and Logic (all-of by default, any-of optional) and a HasPermission method. Core contributes general, notifications, users, roles, groups, departments and positions when admin controllers are registered; logging contributes the business history page. NewSettingsHubController accepts an optional settings.Source, controllers.UserControllerBasePath is added, and the core settings templates package HubPageProps.Sections is now []pkg/settings.ResolvedSection (was []types.SettingsSection).
